---
title: "Tree-based"
---

Tree-based models make predictions by repeatedly dividing the feature space
into smaller regions. Within each final region, a regression tree predicts an
average response and a classification tree predicts a class frequency.

## 1. Decision trees from scratch

**Estimated time:** 45–60 minutes

Build the first two splits of a high-CO decision tree from the gas-turbine
measurements. Compute Gini impurity, search across features and cutpoints, and
then use scikit-learn to draw the same shallow tree.
